content: संवद् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To talk to, address; मैतस्मिन् संवदिष्टा अतिष्ठाः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 1. 2</ls>. .²2 To speak together, converse, discourse. .²3 To resemble, tally with, correspond to, be like (with <ab>instr.</ab>); अस्य मुखं सीताया मुखचन्द्रेण संवदत्येव <ls>U. 4</ls>; अहो संवदन्त्यक्षराणि <ls>Mu. 5</ls>. .²4 To name, call. .²5 To agree, accord, consent. .²6 To coincide, fit together (so as to give one sense). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To consult, hold consultation (with <ab>instr.</ab>); as in मौहूर्तिकैः सह संवाद्यताम्. .²2 To cause to sound, play upon (a musical instrument). .²3 To declare (truly or sincerely); संवाद्य रूपसंख्यादीन् स्वामी तद्द्रव्यमर्हति <ls>Ms. 8. 31</ls>.
